verses.text: I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”
lines: I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue.
I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”

verses.text: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.
lines: I was mute with silence.
I held my peace, even from good.
My sorrow was stirred.

verses.text: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:
lines: My heart was hot within me.
While I meditated, the fire burned.
I spoke with my tongue:

verses.text: “Yahweh, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.
lines: “Yahweh, show me my end,
what is the measure of my days.
Let me know how frail I am.

verses.text: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.”
lines: Behold, you have made my days hand widths.
My lifetime is as nothing before you.
Surely every man stands as a breath.”

verses.text: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.
lines: “Surely every man walks like a shadow.
Surely they busy themselves in vain.
He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.

verses.text: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
lines: Now, Lord, what do I wait for?
My hope is in you.

verses.text: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.
lines: Deliver me from all my transgressions.
Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.

verses.text: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.
lines: I was mute.
I didn’t open my mouth,
because you did it.

verses.text: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.
lines: Remove your scourge away from me.
I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

verses.text: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.”
lines: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity,
you consume his wealth like a moth.
Surely every man is but a breath.”

verses.text: “Hear my prayer, Yahweh, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.
lines: “Hear my prayer, Yahweh, and give ear to my cry.
Don’t be silent at my tears.
For I am a stranger with you,
a foreigner, as all my fathers were.

verses.text: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”
lines: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength,
before I go away and exist no more.”
